_doc: SSOT for LOCAL Claude remote control (phone -> Drive job -> HubClock rider -> this machine's Claude CLI). The transport is line-cursor-agent.json's and is NOT duplicated here: this file only describes the local terminal that transport was missing. forbid_local_sdk in line-cursor-agent.json is a CURSOR OOM constraint (local Cursor SDK Bridge.launch OOMs the IDE) and says nothing about the Claude CLI, so claude_local is a separately gated runtime and never changes the cloud_rest default.

trigger._doc: claude_local is OPT-IN per job. Default runtime stays cloud_rest so an existing phone habit cannot silently change terminal.

cli.name: claude
cli._doc: Resolved with shutil.which so PATHEXT finds claude.CMD; a bare ['claude', ...] argv fails under CreateProcess because CreateProcess only appends .exe.

auth._doc: Values are read straight into a child process environment and never printed, logged, or placed in argv (Windows argv is readable by any same-user process).
auth._three_state_doc: Auth is THREE-state, not two: absent / present_unverified / verified. The env-var, vault and credentials_file scans below prove PRESENCE only — an empty, expired or revoked store still satisfies 'the file exists' and then dies with Not logged in. readiness requires verified, which only check --probe can produce, so the beacon can never promise the phone a machine that will answer Not logged in.
auth._probe_doc: A probe spends one real call, so the verdict is cached in probe_stamp and reused for probe_ttl_sec: that is what lets a @5m rider read 'verified' without spending quota every tick. 12h is long enough that no rider ever probes and short enough that a revoked token stops reading as verified within a day. The stamp holds auth-state only — no token, no prompt, no result — and a FAILED probe is written too, so a revoked credential loses verified status instead of coasting on a stale success. The stamp is bound to the auth_source label it was minted against; changing credential source invalidates it.
auth.operator_only_reason: Minting the token is an interactive browser OAuth. The agent is prohibited from performing logins, so this is the one step that cannot be automated; the token then travels through token-onboard.py and never through chat.

exec._cwd_root_doc: A job's seat decides cwd, and job text arrives from a LINE DM. Even with the owner allowlist the resolved cwd is asserted to sit under cwd_root, so a malformed seat can never aim the CLI outside the hub.
exec._prompt_via_doc: stdin, not argv: argv is world-readable per-user on Windows and caps near 32k chars.

beacon._doc: Written by claude-remote-ready.py at boot and on every rider tick. ready=false with a named blocker is the correct output when auth is missing; UNKNOWN is never reported as ready (same invariant as tray/claude_app_health.py).

boot._doc: The boot guarantee is the EXISTING chain, not a new one: HKCU Run ai_darkhero_hub_tray + Startup VBS backup -> tray/logon_autostart.py -> ensure_hub_tray.py -> hub_tray -> supervisor/lifecycle.py _ensure_hubclock() -> hubclock.py, with rider ai-darkhero-hub-tray-ensure@1m reviving the tray from the other direction. logon_autostart.py additionally fires claude-remote-ready.py once so readiness is asserted at logon rather than at first phone job.
boot._ready_args_doc: --probe-if-stale, not --probe: link 4 must read VERIFIED rather than merely present, but a bare --probe would buy the same verdict again on every reboot. It spends one real call only when probe_stamp is not already a fresh success. logon_autostart.py caps the call at 120s while exec.timeout_sec is 900s; a cut-off probe leaves the stamp unwritten and the terminal reads present_unverified, i.e. fail-closed, retried next boot. Never fails the boot: run_claude_ready's rc is logged, not propagated.

rider._armed_doc: register-rider add = new recurring out-of-turn execution = arming, which is the operator's call (register-rider.py AUTHORIZATION). The boot-time run plus the already-armed line-cursor-agent-bridge@1m are enough for the guarantee; this rider is hardening. Proposal: _inbox/from_projects/ai_darkhero/claude-remote-ready-rider.md

gateway._doc: Free-provider gateway lane (OmniRoute, MIT): used by run_local(lane=auto) when the Anthropic credential is absent/unverified or a run hits a quota marker. Token lives in the vault only (dotted path). Start/inspect with _skill/engines/omniroute-gateway.py.
